context: Import MAX_COMPARE_SELECTIONS in BenchmarkIndex and mirror PlatformIndex's exact pattern: block selection past the cap and expose the reason through aria-describedby, matching PlatformIndex.tsx:767-768 and :961. Do not invent new copy.
description:
PlatformIndex (PlatformIndex.tsx:21,384,767) and Query (Query.tsx:29) both import and enforce MAX_COMPARE_SELECTIONS from resultLinks.ts. BenchmarkIndex does not import it at all, so its selection is uncapped while its two siblings cap at 4. A user can select more runs than the comparison surface accepts, and only discovers the limit on navigation.

Found by adversarial review; not in the original findings.
